map.这个工具怎么用？: How do I use this tool?
map.在对应输入框填入参数，结果区会即时给出计算结果。: Enter the parameters in the fields; the result area updates immediately.
map.选择两个朝代即可查看起止年代、按“无公元 0 年”规则折算的存续年数、并存重叠区: Choose two dynasties to see their start and end years, duration calculated without a year zero, overlap, population ratio, founder, capital, territory and social/economic notes. You can export the complete comparison for the current selection.
map.工具内置从夏朝到现代中国的一组常用朝代数据。对比时先按结束年减开始年计算存续年数: The tool includes a set of commonly used dynasties from the Xia to modern China. Duration starts as end year minus start year; if the range crosses the BCE/CE boundary, subtract one more year because historical chronology has no year zero. Overlap and start-year gaps use the same rule. Population and territory figures carry a reference year, estimation scope and source note; population ratios are order-of-magnitude comparisons only.
map.备课或写作业时核对两个朝代的起止年代、存续时长与并存关系，避免把公元前年份直接相: Check start/end years, duration and overlap for lesson preparation or homework without subtracting BCE years directly.
map.制作历史对比表时，导出当前两个朝代的完整字段，不必逐个翻年表抄录。: Export the complete fields for the two selected dynasties when building a comparison table, instead of copying them from chronology tables one by one.
map.讨论“人口谁更多、疆域谁更大”时，先看清统计年份与估算口径，再决定是否引用倍数。: Before arguing which dynasty had more people or more territory, check the reference year and estimation basis, then decide whether a ratio is worth citing.
map.在“朝代 A”“朝代 B”两个下拉框中选择要比较的政权。: Select the two regimes to compare in the “Dynasty A” and “Dynasty B” drop-downs.
map.点击“对比”，结果区会显示两张朝代卡片和对比分析。: Click “Compare”; the result area shows two dynasty cards and a comparison analysis.
map.需要留存时点击“导出当前对比 CSV”，导出的是当前选择，而不是历史记录；历史记: To keep a record, click “Export current comparison CSV”. It exports the current selection, not the history log; use “Export history CSV” separately for saved runs.
map.引用人口或疆域数字前，阅读结果下方的“数据口径”提示。: Before citing a population or territory figure, read the “Data basis” note below the result.

map.唐 618–907 共 289 年；明 1368–1644 共 276 年；两者: Tang 618–907 lasted 289 years; Ming 1368–1644 lasted 276 years. They do not overlap, and the duration difference is 13 years.
map.三国 220–280 与晋朝 266–420，重叠 266–280 共 14 年: Three Kingdoms 220–280 and Jin 266–420 overlap from 266 to 280, for 14 years.
map.早期王朝的年代存在多种断代观点，本工具采用一组常见年表取值。人口与疆域是学者估算: Early dynasties have multiple chronological reconstructions; this tool uses one common set of dates. Population and territory are scholarly estimates with differing reference years, registered populations and definitions of controlled versus maximum territory, so a population ratio is not a precise census conclusion. Use the results for study and exhibition drafting; verify the underlying sources for publication or academic citation.
map.跨公元前后的年数为什么少 1 年？: Why is a BCE-to-CE span one year shorter?
map.公元前 1 年之后直接进入公元 1 年，没有公元 0 年；因此跨分界计算要扣除这: Year 1 BCE is followed directly by year 1 CE; there is no year zero. The crossing therefore loses one year, and start-year gaps, durations and overlaps all use that rule.
map.人口倍数能直接引用吗？: Can the population ratio be cited directly?
map.不宜直接当作精确结论。各朝人口来自不同学者对高峰期或特定年份的估算，统计范围不同: No. Population figures come from different scholars, reference years and reporting scopes. The tool labels the approximate year and “scholarly estimate”; use the ratio only for order-of-magnitude comparison.
map.“导出当前对比”与“导出历史”有什么区别？: What is the difference between “Export current comparison” and “Export history”?
map.前者按当前两个下拉选择即时生成完整对比表，不受是否点过“对比”影响；后者导出工具: The first builds a complete comparison table from the current two selections even if you have not clicked “Compare”. The second exports saved history records whose result text may be truncated, useful for reviewing past runs.
map.夏朝年代为什么常标“约”？: Why are Xia dynasty dates often marked “approx.”?
map.夏商周年代多依文献与断代工程推定，学界存在区间；工具采用常见取值并在口径提示中说: Xia–Shang–Zhou dates rely on textual evidence and the Xia–Shang–Zhou Chronology Project, and scholarly ranges differ. The tool uses a common set and explains the dispute in its data note; follow the textbook you use when citing.
